execute: Bind artifact version to deployment. Identify the proposed entry, transformation, execution, effect, consumer and consequence. Use existing logs, traces, captures and state observations to correlate the exact input/attempt and product under compatible conditions. Check producer and consumer where both are required. Compare alternatives such as another caller, shared client, cache, proxy or generic error handling. UA, egress address, paths and nearby times are clues. Direct invocation may prove method behavior while ordinary entry reachability remains unknown. Distinguish independent captures from reports of the same capture.
review: Support only linked observed edges. Alternate origin or incompatible version refutes attribution without erasing an observed effect. A network effect followed by an API failure does not establish response consumption or impact. Missing entry, correlation or consumer remains unknown. Stop at unavailable observer or disproved path; reopen for version, proven route, correlated observation or consumer evidence.
